plain_name: Merit tests for structure decisions (real need, smallest structure, output as tiebreaker)
rationale: Real need, smallest sufficient structure, and output value are structural-design judgments that guide review.
activation_trigger: when adding a structure, layer, or process
verification: check the real need, smallest viable structure, and output effect before accepting the design

plain_name: A permanently chosen state is accepted by name in the check, never left red
rationale: Judging whether a state was chosen on purpose is not mechanical, but what to do once it has been chosen is: name the accepted thing exactly, keep it printed on the passing line, and add a case proving every unnamed variant still fails.
activation_trigger: when a check fails on a configuration a human has chosen on purpose
verification: check that the acceptance names the exact identifier rather than a pattern, that the passing output still prints the accepted state, and that a test case proves an unnamed variant still fails

plain_name: Heavy build protocol runs in full, unprompted, once a partner invokes it
rationale: Doctrine heavy-build-protocol names an explicit ordered chain of phases; running them is a repeatable workflow, while how much research or how many slices a given build needs stays contextual.
activation_trigger: when a partner calls for a heavy build or the admission machinery derives work heavy
verification: verify the research corpus, the structured slice register, the review chain receipts and the dispatcher packets all exist for the build, not just the admission filing

plain_name: Build missing record-layer verbs
rationale: The missing-verb boundary requires checking the registry and product task, while the prescribed build path is a repeatable workflow.
activation_trigger: when a product surface needs a record-layer verb that does not exist
verification: verify the missing registry verb, named product blocker, and normal source delivery

plain_name: Repair known issues autonomously
rationale: Determining the known repair and safeguards takes judgment, while repair and briefing are a repeatable workflow.
activation_trigger: when a broken behavior has a known repair
verification: verify the repair, production safeguards, and outcome briefing

plain_name: Apply DoctorCRE surface grammar
rationale: The surface grammar is a product design preference applied by judgment across screens.
activation_trigger: when building or reviewing a DoctorCRE screen
verification: review visible controls, titles, navigation, time inputs, Doc, team language, drag behavior and motion

plain_name: Cloud model choice: pick the model by the work's shape when launching a cloud session
rationale: Whether a job is well-scoped with a checkable done-condition, or is design, gate, eval-design or review work, is a judgment about the job; the routing itself is a repeatable workflow with a named split between Sonnet 5.5 at medium effort and Opus 5.5.
activation_trigger: when dispatching work to another model or launching a Claude Code cloud session
verification: verify the chosen model and effort match the work's shape, and that any lane floor Joe set still holds

plain_name: Size every new piece of work before execution
rationale: Selecting tiny, medium-to-large, or beyond-one-session requires judgment about the work's shape, while the required sizing and routing sequence is repeatable.
activation_trigger: when starting a new piece of work
verification: verify the work was sized first and routed to one-go, /grill-with-docs, or /wayfinder without starting at /wayfinder
